comment: Hand-authored. Maps every term the research seed uses that is not a representation's own id onto
named structures of a registered representation (packages/atlas-research/src/representations.ts).
Targets are side-free structure labels; the resolver expands them to every side that ships.
how: exact-term when the target is the term's concept or its complete set of parts; crosswalk when
boundaries differ. Every crosswalk link is approximate and shows `why`. HCP-MMP1 entries are
always crosswalk. A target may be held by the asset owner; it is listed anyway, so that clearing it
later resolves with no edit here. tools/check-crosswalk.mjs refuses a target that is not a
structure of the representation, shipped or held, and a seed term with no entry.
Every HCP-MMP1 entry also targets the lobe of icbm152-2009c-cortex-lobes (owner card 6a774981, DOG-151):
an area is smaller than its lobe, so the lobe link is a crosswalk too. Its labels are the contract posted on
DOG-151; until that label file is on the tree, tools/check-crosswalk.mjs reports these targets UNVERIFIED.
licence: Apache-2.0, first-party (GStack). Names Z-Anatomy structures by label, as identifiers, the way registration/mni-to-zanatomy-2929e94.json does; carries no geometry. Not in payloadDirs, so it does not ship; whoever ships it adds an attribution.json entry, and licence rule 5 refuses it until they do.

entries.label: Area 1 (somatosensory)
entries.why: an HCP-MMP1 area is a multimodal cortical parcel; it is smaller than the gyrus it is projected onto and its border follows no sulcus. Area 1 lies on the crown of the postcentral gyrus.
entries.reference: Glasser MF et al. (2016) A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex. Nature 536:171-178, doi:10.1038/nature18933; Supplementary Neuroanatomical Results, area descriptions

entries.label: Primary somatosensory cortex (area 3b)
entries.why: an HCP-MMP1 area is a multimodal cortical parcel; it is smaller than the gyrus it is projected onto and its border follows no sulcus. Area 3b lies in the posterior bank of the central sulcus, so both are named. On the lobe cortex the central sulcus is the frontal-parietal boundary, and area 3b lies on its posterior (parietal) side.
entries.reference: Glasser MF et al. (2016) A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex. Nature 536:171-178, doi:10.1038/nature18933; Supplementary Neuroanatomical Results, area descriptions

entries.reference: Glasser MF et al. (2016) A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex. Nature 536:171-178, doi:10.1038/nature18933; Supplementary Neuroanatomical Results, area descriptions

entries.reference: Glasser MF et al. (2016) A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex. Nature 536:171-178, doi:10.1038/nature18933; Supplementary Neuroanatomical Results, area descriptions

entries.why: an HCP-MMP1 area is a multimodal cortical parcel; it is smaller than the gyrus it is projected onto and its border follows no sulcus. Area 55b lies at the junction of the posterior middle frontal gyrus and the precentral gyrus, so both are named.
entries.reference: Glasser MF et al. (2016) A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex. Nature 536:171-178, doi:10.1038/nature18933; Supplementary Neuroanatomical Results, area descriptions

entries.why: an HCP-MMP1 area is a multimodal cortical parcel; it is smaller than the gyrus it is projected onto and its border follows no sulcus. Area 7Pm is one of several areas on the precuneus.
entries.reference: Glasser MF et al. (2016) A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex. Nature 536:171-178, doi:10.1038/nature18933; Supplementary Neuroanatomical Results, area descriptions

entries.reference: Glasser MF et al. (2016) A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex. Nature 536:171-178, doi:10.1038/nature18933; Supplementary Neuroanatomical Results, area descriptions

entries.reference: Glasser MF et al. (2016) A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex. Nature 536:171-178, doi:10.1038/nature18933; Supplementary Neuroanatomical Results, area descriptions

entries.reference: Glasser MF et al. (2016) A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex. Nature 536:171-178, doi:10.1038/nature18933; Supplementary Neuroanatomical Results, area descriptions

entries.why: an HCP-MMP1 area is a multimodal cortical parcel; it is smaller than the gyrus it is projected onto and its border follows no sulcus. FFC is one area on the fusiform (lateral occipitotemporal) gyrus.
entries.reference: Glasser MF et al. (2016) A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex. Nature 536:171-178, doi:10.1038/nature18933; Supplementary Neuroanatomical Results, area descriptions

entries.label: Frontal opercular area 4

targets.label: Opercular part of inferior frontal gyrus

entries.why: an HCP-MMP1 area is a multimodal cortical parcel; it is smaller than the gyrus it is projected onto and its border follows no sulcus. FOP4 lies on the inner frontal operculum toward the circular sulcus of the insula; both are named and neither is the area.
entries.reference: Glasser MF et al. (2016) A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex. Nature 536:171-178, doi:10.1038/nature18933; Supplementary Neuroanatomical Results, area descriptions

entries.reference: Glasser MF et al. (2016) A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex. Nature 536:171-178, doi:10.1038/nature18933; Supplementary Neuroanatomical Results, area descriptions

entries.reference: Glasser MF et al. (2016) A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex. Nature 536:171-178, doi:10.1038/nature18933; Supplementary Neuroanatomical Results, area descriptions

entries.label: Area PGs (angular gyrus)
entries.why: an HCP-MMP1 area is a multimodal cortical parcel; it is smaller than the gyrus it is projected onto and its border follows no sulcus. PGs lies on the superior angular gyrus.
entries.reference: Glasser MF et al. (2016) A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex. Nature 536:171-178, doi:10.1038/nature18933; Supplementary Neuroanatomical Results, area descriptions

entries.label: Parahippocampal area 1
entries.why: an HCP-MMP1 area is a multimodal cortical parcel; it is smaller than the gyrus it is projected onto and its border follows no sulcus. PHA1 lies on the posterior parahippocampal gyrus. On the lobe cortex it is filed under both the limbic and the temporal lobe, because conventions differ on where the parahippocampal gyrus belongs.
entries.reference: Glasser MF et al. (2016) A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex. Nature 536:171-178, doi:10.1038/nature18933; Supplementary Neuroanatomical Results, area descriptions

entries.label: Retrosplenial complex
entries.why: an HCP-MMP1 area is a multimodal cortical parcel; it is smaller than the gyrus it is projected onto and its border follows no sulcus. RSC lies behind the splenium on the isthmus of the cingulate gyrus, which is Z-Anatomy's posteroventral cingulate part.
entries.reference: Glasser MF et al. (2016) A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex. Nature 536:171-178, doi:10.1038/nature18933; Supplementary Neuroanatomical Results, area descriptions

entries.why: an HCP-MMP1 area is a multimodal cortical parcel; it is smaller than the gyrus it is projected onto and its border follows no sulcus. SFL lies on the superior frontal gyrus near its medial border.
entries.reference: Glasser MF et al. (2016) A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex. Nature 536:171-178, doi:10.1038/nature18933; Supplementary Neuroanatomical Results, area descriptions

entries.label: Superior temporal sulcus, ventral posterior
entries.why: an HCP-MMP1 area is a multimodal cortical parcel; it is smaller than the gyrus it is projected onto and its border follows no sulcus. STSvp lies in the lower bank of the posterior superior temporal sulcus.
entries.reference: Glasser MF et al. (2016) A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex. Nature 536:171-178, doi:10.1038/nature18933; Supplementary Neuroanatomical Results, area descriptions

entries.reference: Glasser MF et al. (2016) A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex. Nature 536:171-178, doi:10.1038/nature18933; Supplementary Neuroanatomical Results, area descriptions

entries.why: an HCP-MMP1 area is a multimodal cortical parcel; it is smaller than the gyrus it is projected onto and its border follows no sulcus. TGd is the dorsal part of the temporal pole.
entries.reference: Glasser MF et al. (2016) A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex. Nature 536:171-178, doi:10.1038/nature18933; Supplementary Neuroanatomical Results, area descriptions

entries.label: Primary visual cortex (V1)
entries.why: an HCP-MMP1 area is a multimodal cortical parcel; it is smaller than the gyrus it is projected onto and its border follows no sulcus. V1 lies in the banks of the calcarine sulcus and spills onto its lips.
entries.reference: Glasser MF et al. (2016) A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex. Nature 536:171-178, doi:10.1038/nature18933; Supplementary Neuroanatomical Results, area descriptions

entries.label: Second visual area (V2)
entries.why: an HCP-MMP1 area is a multimodal cortical parcel; it is smaller than the gyrus it is projected onto and its border follows no sulcus. V2 surrounds V1 on the cuneus above and the lingual gyrus below.
entries.reference: Glasser MF et al. (2016) A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex. Nature 536:171-178, doi:10.1038/nature18933; Supplementary Neuroanatomical Results, area descriptions

entries.label: amygdala
entries.why: the brain mesh has no whole amygdala; it ships the CIT168 amygdala nuclear groups, and whether they tile the whole amygdala is not verified here

entries.label: anterior cingulate cortex

targets.label: Cingulate gyrus and sulcus (Middle anterior part)

entries.why: Z-Anatomy divides the cingulate gyrus into Destrieux-style parts and carries no pregenual (anterior) part. Its middle anterior part is the anterior MID-cingulate cortex (aMCC), not the pregenual ACC, so this is the nearest modelled neighbour, not the structure named

entries.label: brainstem
entries.why: the brainstem is the midbrain, pons and medulla oblongata; a finding filed under the whole brainstem names no one of them

entries.label: fusiform gyrus
entries.why: the fusiform gyrus is the lateral occipitotemporal gyrus (Terminologia Anatomica), but its anterior and posterior limits differ between atlases

targets.label: Opercular part of inferior frontal gyrus
Triangular part of inferior frontal gyrus
Orbital part of  inferior frontal gyrus

entries.label: insular cortex

targets.label: Insula (Subcentral gyrus and ant. and post. sulci*)

entries.why: Z-Anatomy models the insula as the circular sulcus and a subcentral unit, not as the short and long insular gyri; the union approximates the insular cortex

entries.label: occipital lobe
entries.why: the occipital lobe has no mesh of its own; these are the Z-Anatomy gyri and sulci that lie within it, and its anterior border is a convention, not a sulcus

entries.label: parahippocampal gyrus
entries.why: Z-Anatomy files the parahippocampal gyrus as the medial occipitotemporal gyrus, whose posterior part is lingual in some atlases

entries.label: posterior cingulate cortex

targets.label: Cingulate gyrus and sulcus (Posterior dorsal part)

entries.why: the posterior cingulate cortex spans Z-Anatomy's posterior dorsal and posteroventral cingulate parts, and its border with the middle cingulate differs between atlases

entries.label: superior temporal gyrus
entries.why: Z-Anatomy divides the superior temporal gyrus into its lateral surface, the temporal plane and the transverse gyri, and carries no planum polare

entries.label: thalamus
entries.why: the brain mesh has no whole thalamus; it ships thalamic nuclei (Najdenovska, and the geniculate bodies), and whether they tile the whole thalamus is not verified here

entries.label: coronary artery
entries.why: no registered representation names the coronary arteries: the cleared BD index carries 57 BodyParts3D structures and they are not among them, and the brain mesh is the brain

entries.label: quadratus lumborum
entries.why: no registered representation names the quadratus lumborum: it is not among the 57 structures of the cleared BD index

entries.label: 7th rib
entries.why: no registered representation names an individual rib: the cleared BD index carries a generic rib (FMA7574) only, and filing a 7th-rib finding under it would claim every rib
